card.fact_statement: The Department of the Interior and Local Government alerted local politicians of high-risk areas during the 2025 Philippine monsoon floods.
card.answer: Department of the Interior and Local Government
card.source_span: the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla alerted local politicians of high-risk areas
